highlights: [2.23.1] Improve: Now app wil detect paused download and offer resume
fullchange: [2.23.1] Improve: Device identity (deviceId) is now frozen per machine + GST and persisted with the serials and encryption secret in config/secret.json — it can no longer change on re-registration
[2.23.1] Fix: GST edits no longer make older encrypted logs unreadable — log decryption now retries keys derived from previous GST numbers kept in the identity store
[2.23.1] Fix: Cloud Connect now uses the same hardware-bound deviceId as app registration (one id per machine) instead of a per-install random id
[2.23.1] Improve: The encryption secret now falls back to the identity store if the OS keychain loses it, so log history stays decryptable
[2.23.1] Improve: Hardware serial detection hardened (timeouts, fallback sources) and themed announcement/help re-fetch after registration so slow machines no longer miss them
